notes: Historical annual frequency of reported incident points, not a calibrated future probability or property burn probability.
Only the published USFS FPA FOD archive is used for frequencies; live WFIGS records and unfinished recent years are excluded.
Each year counts at most once per radius, even when many fires are reported. Radii are nested and their frequencies must not be added.
Points can be approximate to a one-square-mile PLSS section; distance is to the reported point, not the fire perimeter.
Reporting omissions, changes in reporting, fuels and climate are not corrected. US records only; cross-border fires may be omitted.
A zero observed frequency does not establish zero future risk. Reference intervals assume independent, comparable years and omit reporting and model uncertainty.
data.reason: Years with at least one reported fire in the radius divided by all published baseline years.

meta.purpose: Historical annual reported-fire frequencies; not calibrated future probabilities or property damage estimates.

notes: Point query includes county- and zone-based alert products; geographic precision varies.

No returned alerts does not establish safety or zero long-term risk.

notes: Census-tract community index published by FEMA; describes the whole tract, not this property.
Scores are national percentile rankings (0-100) and ratings are relative categories, not probabilities.
Expected annual loss is FEMA's modeled tract total across buildings, population equivalence and agriculture, in USD.
'Not Applicable' and 'No Rating' are source categories; they do not mean zero hazard at this point.
Composite values are FEMA's own index; NDApp does not combine hazards or create a new score.
Hosted on the ArcGIS Online tenant that serves FEMA's NRI report layers; check nri_version for vintage.
